_comment: A-W2 spec D3.2. The request bodies the iPhone sends to the «Mensajes del servicio» doors (/api/app/v1/admin/service-threads/{roleId}/...). The iOS XCTest encodes each request type and asserts this exact JSON; the vitest test feeds each body to the writer's own parser and asserts what it reads. `observed: null` must be sent explicitly: a missing `observed` is refused by parsePastorMessageEdit.
